title: When the mind keeps arguing with what is already here
issueStatement: Reality has arrived, but the mind is still bargaining for a different version of it, as if peace must wait until life agrees with private preference.
centralInsight: Gurbani reframes peace as reading life inside Hukam. The soul relaxes when it stops confusing response with authorship.
practicalReflection: Acceptance is not passivity. It is the release of false authorship, so faithful action can begin without the extra burden of trying to be the maker of everything.
actionPrompt: Stop negotiating with one part of reality long enough to answer it faithfully instead.
